verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents product tax codes (PTCs) that determine tax rates based on product type (SaaS, digital goods, services, physical goods) and lets Stripe apply a preset PTC when none is set on a specific item, which is exactly the catalog-mapping mechanism the story asks for. However, community feedback specifically flags coverage gaps when selling internationally ('woefully incomplete' for international jurisdictions), and there's no independent verification that every category/jurisdiction combination is accurately handled. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of correct taxability across all four category types and all jurisdictions, and clearer documentation addressing the international completeness gap raised by users.
